newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech Rafinerska sees 1996 gross over CZK 1 bln.
newsitem.headline: Czech Rafinerska sees 1996 gross over CZK 1 bln.

text.p: Czech refinery Ceska Rafinerska a.s. said on Friday its 1996 pre-tax profit was expected to exceed one billion crowns.
Company spokesman Ales Soukup said the firm's sales of petrol and diesel fuels rose to over three million tonnes last year from 2.5 million combined sales of its predecessors in 1995.
"Those are all preliminary data," Soukup told Reuters. No further results were available.
In a deal completed last year, the IOC consortium of three foreign oil groups bought a 49 percent stake in the company, set up to operate the two main Czech refineries at Litvinov and Kralupy.

The IOC is equally owned by DuPont Co unit Conoco of the United States, Royal Dutch/Shell, and Italy's Agip SpA. The state holds the remaining 51 percent stake in Rafinerska through holding company Unipetrol a.s.
